methods.label: Compare everyone with Pedro
methods.explanation:
Compare all finishing times with Pedro's so that every clue uses the same reference. Olympia finished \(3\) minutes after Pedro. Melina finished \(2\) minutes after Olympia, so she finished \(3+2=5\) minutes after Pedro. Luke finished \(6\) minutes after Olympia, so he finished \(3+6=9\) minutes after Pedro. Nico finished \(11\) minutes after Pedro.

The delays after Pedro are therefore
\[
0<3<5<9<11.
\]
A smaller delay means an earlier finish, so the order is Pedro, Olympia, Melina, Luke, Nico. Thus \(\boxed{\text{Luke}}\) finished fourth, choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
